title: Session 9
description:
S1
Asbestos removal crews start work in an abandoned insane asylum, and strange happenings begin to occur.

title: SiREN
description:
S1
A man visits a supernatural nightclub during his bachelor party and inadvertently crosses paths with a dancer who is actually a terrifying, legendary creature.

title: The Skulls
description:
S1
A freshman (Joshua Jackson) joins an elite society that will guarantee him success, but he questions his decision when his reporter roommate dies mysteriously.

title: The Skulls II
description:
S1
A new inductee (Robin Dunne) into the secret society witnesses a murder at the hands of one of its members.

title: The Skulls III
description:
S1
A young woman (Clare Kramer) gets more than she bargained for when she gains entrance to a males-only secret society.

title: The Spider Woman Strikes Back
description:
S1
She (Gale Sondergaard) and her hulking servant grow bloodsucking plants, as a young woman (Brenda Joyce) finds out.

title: Stephanie
description:
S1
After a mysterious global catastrophe, a young girl is left alone to hide from a malevolent power that stalks her home.

title: Virus
description:
S1
Passengers (Jamie Lee Curtis, William Baldwin, Donald Sutherland) on a sinking ship board a seemingly deserted Russian vessel containing a mutating alien force.
